decisions.reason: Preserving existing campaigns does not change the required MeetAlfred configuration or subscription plan.
The preservation instruction does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method or lifecycle.
The separate testing-isolation clause from the source message is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; no additional change is required.
Preserving existing campaigns does not change the deferred email campaign's channel, automation mode, platform, or lifecycle.
The instruction protects existing campaigns but does not modify the required LinkedIn campaign's channel, automation mode, or platform.
The follow-up workflow already requires no manual cleanup of prior campaigns, and the source does not change its workflow or deferred lifecycle.
Campaign preservation does not change the deferred Zapier configuration requirement or its scope.
The source instruction concerns existing MeetAlfred campaigns and does not alter the requirement to create a campaign domain.
Preserving MeetAlfred campaigns does not modify any HubSpot lead-management feature or attribute.
The source does not change the required visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
The instruction to preserve existing campaigns does not change the independent domain warm-up obligation.
The preservation instruction does not alter duplicate-status behavior or its display on LinkedIn profiles.
